imagery.style: High contrast, dark cinematic sports aesthetics, realistic turf and nets. Avoid cartoonish or flat vectors. Use heavy bottom/top gradients on hero overlays to ensure text readability.

hero.layout: 100vh min-height, content horizontally centered. Image positioned absolute with overlay.
hero.content: Heading: 'Train. Practice. Dominate.' Subtitle: 'Premium Cricket Coaching & Ground Booking.' CTAs: 'Book Ground', 'Join Academy'.

about_and_stats.layout: Asymmetric bento grid. Left side: Text/Story. Right side: 4 Stat/Feature blocks (2 Grounds, Pro Coaching, Astro Turf, Indoor & Outdoor). Use high contrast typography for numbers.

facilities.layout: Dense functional grid (grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-5). Minimalist icon + text approach, dark cards.

grounds.layout: 2 large vertical cards (md:col-span-1 each). Image on top, dense details below. Chinnaswamy Ground Marsur 1 & 2. Include embedded 'Book Now' CTA.

booking_system.flow: Select ground -> Select date -> Display slot cards -> Modal form for booking.

programs_and_pricing.layout: 3-column pricing tier card layout. Tiers: Nets (₹250/hr), Coaching (₹3000/mo), 1-on-1 (₹12000).

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (left) + Data-dense tables using Shadcn UI (right). Dark mode optimized.

icons.style: stroke-width 1.5, color #C7F041 for primary actions, #FFFFFF for general UI.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST use standard HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout elements to ensure freedom of design. Use pure flex/grid instead of generic containers.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactive pieces: Dialogs, Selects, Forms, and the Admin Dashboard tables.
The color #C7F041 (Lime Green) is extremely aggressive. Use it ONLY for CTAs, active states, and small accents (like icons or thin borders). Never use it as a large background area.
All Headings (H1, H2, H3) MUST use the Bebas Neue font. Use Poppins for body text.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards that open modals, etc.) for testing.
Add `font-bebas` class for titles and `font-poppins` class for normal text.
Do NOT use placeholder text or placeholder images. ONLY use the Unsplash URLs provided in this file.
The overall tone is a crossover between a premium golf club and Manchester United Foundation - it should feel established, professional, and slightly intimidating/elite.
